# Delta Chat Webxdc runtime assets

`app/src/main/assets/webxdc/` contains the original `webxdc.js`, sandbox bootstrap, and WebRTC isolation check from [Delta Chat Android v2.69.0](https://github.com/deltachat/deltachat-android/tree/v2.69.0/src/main/res/raw). They are distributed under GPL-3.0. See the license in this directory.

Relay Lab supplies a Compose UI and connects the JavaScript bridge to Chatmail Core's JSON-RPC interface.
